title: Frank Sinatra Sinatra 80th Live in Concert CD 1995 Capitol Pavarotti Duet
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Frank Sinatra - Sinatra 80th: Live in Concert
(Capitol CDP 7243 8 31723 2 0, 1995).

Live recordings released for Sinatra's 80th birthday, including the
"My Way" duet with Luciano Pavarotti. See the photographed back insert
for the full track listing.

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
